campus.name: iCode Old Bridge
campus.tagline: Coding, robotics & STEM classes for kids
campus.status_detail: Our campus is under construction and opens Fall 2026. The Founding Families waitlist is open now — join for priority enrollment and early rates.
campus.service_area: Old Bridge, NJ and surrounding Middlesex County communities

programs.name: Foundation Belt
programs.description: Game development with Scratch, a beginner-friendly visual programming language. Kids build their own games and animations with block-based coding while learning variables, loops, and conditional statements.
programs.duration: One belt typically takes 8-9 months (about one school year).

programs.name: White Belt
programs.description: Robotics program built on the VEX platform. Students model, create, and program robots to solve real-world problems, learning essential engineering, robotics, and design concepts plus 3D modeling.
programs.duration: One belt typically takes 8-9 months (about one school year).

programs.name: Orange Belt
programs.description: Web development: students learn HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build real websites, plus design and photography skills to make their pages come to life.
programs.duration: One belt typically takes 8-9 months (about one school year).

programs.name: Yellow Belt
programs.description: App development: from storyboarding to coding to marketing, students build a mobile or desktop app of their own, then collaborate on more complex open-source style projects.
programs.duration: One belt typically takes 8-9 months (about one school year).

programs.name: STEM Camps
programs.description: Week-long immersive camps during summer, spring break, and school holidays. Full-day and half-day options with themes like game design, robotics, 3D printing, drones, and Minecraft modding.
programs.duration: One week per camp; full-day and half-day options.

programs.name: Tech Clubs
programs.description: Weekly hands-on STEM sessions hosted at local schools — robotics, game design, and coding with peers.
programs.duration: Weekly sessions during the school year.

faq.q: What ages does iCode Old Bridge serve?
faq.a: Ages 6-17, from early elementary through high school.

faq.q: Does my child need coding experience?
faq.a: No. Beginners are welcome — students are matched to the right starting level, and no prior experience is needed for the Foundation Belt.

faq.q: When does the Old Bridge campus open?
faq.a: Fall 2026. The campus is under construction now, and the Founding Families waitlist is open for priority enrollment and early rates.

faq.q: How long does it take to complete a belt?
faq.a: One belt usually takes 8-9 months, roughly one school year. Students progress through belts as they master skills.

faq.q: Can we try a class before enrolling?
faq.a: Yes — families can schedule a trial class. Join the waitlist and mention you'd like a trial, and the campus team will reach out.
Yes — week-long STEM camps run during summer, spring break, and school holidays, with full-day and half-day options.
Pricing will be announced closer to opening. Founding Families on the waitlist get early rates and priority enrollment — joining the waitlist is free.

privacy:
Privacy Policy — iCode Old Bridge Connector
Last updated: September 26, 2026

What we collect
- When you join the Founding Families waitlist, we collect the parent/guardian
  name, a contact (phone number or email address), the child's age, and the
  programs you are interested in. Providing a child's name is optional.

Why we collect it
- To contact you about the campus opening, enrollment priority, trial classes,
  and programs matching your child's age and interests. Nothing else.

What we do not do
- We do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing.
- We do not collect payment information through this connector.

Storage and retention
- Waitlist records are stored securely and kept until the campus opens and
  enrollment outreach is complete, or until you ask us to delete them.

Your choices
- Reply to any message from us, or call (732) 426-3325, to update or delete
  your waitlist entry at any time.

Contact
- iCode Old Bridge, 207 Texas Rd, Old Bridge, NJ 08857, (732) 426-3325.
